evidence.title: Open Foundry | Curated Fonts for Free

name: Open Foundry
summary: Curated showcase of open-source typefaces with specimens, licence details and links to project pages.
description: A hand-picked showcase of open-source fonts (Inter, Roboto, Work Sans, Oswald, League Gothic, EB Garamond, Junicode …) with specimen pages that list classification, licence, creator and weights. Open Foundry is a display, not a distribution platform — downloads live on the fonts' own project or GitHub pages. Independently curated, non-commercial, by the team behind Dreamtype™.
contains: hand-picked open-source fonts, e.g. Inter, Roboto, Work Sans, Oswald, League Gothic
specimen pages with classification, licence, creator and weights
no downloads hosted; links to each font's project or GitHub page
only fonts with open-source licences (SIL, MIT …)
no paid placements; curated by the makers of Dreamtype™
